## Behavior and outcome

Describe the user-visible problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue being completed.

## BDD evidence

- Scenario IDs in `Behaviors/`:
- Red: command and expected failure observed before implementation:
- Green: command and passing outcome after implementation:
- Refactor and regression checks:
- Manual/device acceptance, screenshots and remaining limits:
- README gallery: refreshed images/device coverage, capture source/version, desktop/mobile render and link checks; or precise unchanged/blocked reason:

For documentation-only changes, say so and record content/link checks. For adoption of an existing
test, label it baseline adoption and never invent a red run. New/changed behavior still needs a
reproducing regression test. Structural binding checks do not prove the assertions match the story.

## Validation and documentation

Record commands and outcomes required by AGENTS.md, affected documentation/release notes, and any
remaining acceptance. Describe merged and published status separately; no upload claim without receipt.
